answer: Hardware reservation sets the bill: the tenth identity under one operator consumes ten more physical signing modules, and ten identities leave 55 modules dedicated. violet attests each module’s unique hardware root. wharf groups enrolments by iris attestation; terrace activates identity \(k\) only when \(k\) new modules permanently bind to it, updating that operator’s count atomically. A debut binds one. Existing bindings persist, so fresh wallets, new hosts and parallel enrolment cannot reuse hardware, divide a binding or reset \(k\).
